# Docs Nav Rules

- Keep the docs navigation aligned with the current task-oriented IA rather than a broad page dump.
- Do not promote contributor docs, generated output, or internal maintainer notes into the user docs nav.
- Prefer a small curated examples surface over a large gallery.
- If the nav structure or page ownership changes, consult `.design/reference/docs_layout_plan.md` first.
